cards.title: Today’s vocabulary
sections: right away · /raɪt əˈweɪ/ · phrase · Phrase · New
Immediately, without waiting. We need to leave right away.
leave a place especially on a journey. The train departs at twelve.
To move or do something quickly. We need to hurry to the station.
To arrive too late for a bus, train or other planned event. Do not miss the last bus.
Up to a stated time. The office is open until six.

cards.title: Say late
sections: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides. Join the sounds into one word without adding extra vowels.
Listen. Say it. Record a second attempt after checking one sound.

articulation.label: late
articulation.alt: late: /l/ → /eɪ/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /l/: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides.
/ɪ/: Raise the front tongue; narrow the jaw gap.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
